role: Federal agency commenter on draft EIS
stance_basis: multiple paraphrased comments requesting more detail, raising concerns about site conditions, psychological impacts, mineral industries, and format corrections
summary: The Department of the Interior submitted multiple comments on the draft Environmental Impact Statement for Operation BREAKTHROUGH, raising concerns about insufficient site-specific details, site conditions and amenities, psychological impacts of dense housing, future development controls, mineral industry impacts, prior use of new materials, solid waste utilization, and an incorrect format. HUD responded to each comment, generally pointing to the final statement for elaboration or explaining why certain issues were outside the scope of BREAKTHROUGH.
complaint_summary: The Department of the Interior cited prior attempts to utilize new materials, referencing the 'Lustron' home as possibly rejected due to sociological or environmental problems.
summary_quote: Comment: Develop details for each site.
